| card/fn/Card:remove | card.lua:4727-4771 | function | `Card:remove()` |  | unreviewed |  |  |  | CANDIDATE GAP: a playing card that went through add_to_deck (shop purchase, Standard pack pick, Cryptid or DNA copy) has added_to_deck set, so its removal runs remove_from_deck, which queues set_blind(nil, true): a boss re-debuff pass over G.playing_cards. Neither engine sets added_to_deck on playing cards, so cards.rs::Game::remove_card queues no pass (e.g. under Verdant Leaf, Marble's Stone stays undebuffed after Trading Card destroys a picked card). The rest is ported in cards.rs::Game::remove_card (G123, G125) |
